chart.$comment: A chart: a scene of scales and the marks drawn on them (0099). The colours are the series palette of the skin, by place, and the lines and words of the axes; the type is the small size, because an axis label sits beside the data rather than being read as prose. The line width and the gap between an axis and its labels are the chart's own.

font-size.$description: Font size of the axis labels, the units and the empty message.
